anomaly.plan: Volcanion lead for Lucario; exploit free switches, Cresselia extended Trick Room and Magearna doubled Calm Mind. Keep Volcanion Haze available for escalating boosts.

follow_up.between_round_heals: Full HP/status/PP: pbDoubleTrainerBattle heals player and partner after each battle while partner registered.
follow_up.preparation: Consider acquiring Tapu Fini and other Tapus before committing to Euphie chain; Misty Surge counters Psychic Terrain/Psych Up. Keep Haze and strong physical attacker for evasion/stat chains. Inspect exit access after Jirachi capture.

capture.plan: Paralyze with Zapdos; weaken cautiously while Cosmic Power boosts accumulate, using Cresselia Psychic for tiny resisted chip near low HP. Timer Balls. No Double-Edge/recoil in actual final four, no Rest. Watch PP/Struggle late; budget18Timer+20Ultra from prequest bag.
